// @vitest-environment jsdom
/**
 * Generator of the golden save fixture in tests/fixtures/saves/story/ (see the README there): a career of the
 * first version told in chapters (docs/STORY.md), written through its own store and engine.
 *
 * It must run against the code of the version whose saves it records, never a later one. From the repository
 * root of that version:
 *   cp tests/fixtures/saves/story/generator.test.ts.txt tests/zz-gen-story-fixture.test.ts
 *   EPD_FIXTURE_OUT=/tmp/fixtures-out npx vitest run tests/zz-gen-story-fixture.test.ts
 *   rm tests/zz-gen-story-fixture.test.ts
 * Without EPD_FIXTURE_OUT the test is skipped. The run is deterministic (fixed clock, seeded bot), so the same
 * code gives the same file.
 */
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const OUT = process.env.EPD_FIXTURE_OUT;

let seed = 12345;
const rand = () => {
  seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0;
  return seed / 2 ** 32;
};

/** Store a persisted value byte for byte as the browser held it. */
function writeRaw(name: string, raw: string | null) {
  if (raw === null) throw new Error(`nothing stored for ${name}`);
  JSON.parse(raw); // must be valid JSON
  mkdirSync(OUT!, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(`${OUT}/${name}`, raw);
}

describe('generate the story save fixture', () => {
  it.skipIf(!OUT)('writes a career in its first chapter with objectives met and a question waiting', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] });
    vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-19T06:30:00Z'));
    localStorage.clear();
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(async () => {
      throw new TypeError('Failed to fetch');
    }));
    await import('@/net/account');

    const { useCareer } = await import('@/store/career');
    const { useGame, stopLoop } = await import('@/store/game');
    const rules = await import('@/sim/career');
    const { careerSectors } = await import('@/sim/careerSectors');
    const { step } = await import('@/sim/engine');
    const cmd = await import('@/sim/commands');
    const { pendingRadio, queue, recommendUnits } = await import('@/sim/selectors');
    const { correctReply } = await import('@/sim/registry');
    const { tallinnTime, MIN } = await import('@/sim/time');
    type SimState = import('@/sim/types').SimState;
    const QUESTIONS = ['what', 'where', 'injured', 'weapons', 'suspect'] as const;

    function bot(s: SimState, tick: number) {
      for (const call of s.calls) {
        if (call.endedAt) continue;
        if (!call.answeredAt) cmd.answerCall(s, call.id);
        else if (call.asked.length < QUESTIONS.length) cmd.askCall(s, call.id, QUESTIONS[call.asked.length]);
        else cmd.endCall(s, call.id, { action: 'create', priority: s.incidents[call.incidentId]?.truePriority ?? 3 });
      }
      for (const inc of queue(s)) {
        if (inc.state === 'incoming') cmd.acknowledge(s, inc.id);
        const need = inc.need.reduce((a, n) => a + n.count, 0);
        if (inc.assigned.length === 0 || (tick % 7 === 0 && inc.assigned.length < need)) {
          const recs = recommendUnits(s, inc.id).filter((r) => r.fit === 'ideal' || r.fit === 'need' || r.fit === 'weak');
          const want = Math.max(1, need) - inc.assigned.length;
          if (recs.length && want > 0) cmd.dispatchUnits(s, inc.id, recs.slice(0, want).map((r) => r.unit.id));
        }
        for (const n of inc.agencyNeeds) if (!n.requested) cmd.requestAgency(s, inc.id, n.agency);
      }
      for (const msg of pendingRadio(s)) {
        if (!msg.replies?.length) continue;
        let replyId = msg.replies[0].id;
        if (msg.kind === 'query' && msg.incidentId) {
          const inc = s.incidents[msg.incidentId];
          const subj = inc?.persons.find((p) => msg.text.et.includes(s.persons[p.personId]?.idcode ?? '§§'));
          const veh = inc?.vehicles.find((v) => msg.text.et.includes(v.plate));
          if (subj || veh) {
            const truth = correctReply(s, subj ? { personId: subj.personId } : { plate: veh!.plate });
            if (rand() < 0.9 && msg.replies.some((r) => r.id === truth)) replyId = truth;
          }
        } else if (msg.kind === 'backup' || msg.kind === 'choice') {
          replyId = msg.replies[Math.floor(rand() * msg.replies.length)].id;
        }
        cmd.replyRadio(s, msg.id, replyId);
      }
    }

    // ── A new career at the Tartu linn desk ───────────────────────────────────
    useCareer.getState().create('Liisa Kuusk', '318', 'louna', 'louna-tartu');

    // ── Real shifts until the mentor's question waits and an objective is met ──
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const st = useCareer.getState().profile!.story!;
      if (i >= 2 && st.choice && st.done.length) break;
      vi.setSystemTime(new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 19 + i, 4, 0)));
      const p = useCareer.getState().profile!;
      useGame.getState().startShift({
        seed: 8200 + i * 17,
        regionId: p.regionId,
        mode: 'career',
        difficulty: 'normal',
        start: tallinnTime(2026, 10, 19 + i, 7, 0),
        hours: 8,
        playerName: p.name,
        roster: rules.rosterFromCareer(p, 'day'),
        upgrades: p.upgrades,
        reputation: p.reputation,
        sectors: careerSectors(p, p.regionId),
        openPosts: p.openPosts,
      });
      stopLoop();
      const s = useGame.getState().sim!;
      for (let t = 0; t < 8.5 * 60 * 2 && !s.ended; t++) {
        step(s, MIN / 2);
        bot(s, t);
      }
      useCareer.getState().applyReport(useGame.getState().endShift()!);
      useGame.getState().quitShift();
    }
    const p = useCareer.getState().profile!;
    expect(p.story!.chapter).toBe(1);
    expect(p.story!.choice).toMatchObject({ id: 'c1-debrief' });
    writeRaw('epd-career.json', localStorage.getItem('epd:career'));
    console.log('career', JSON.stringify({ day: p.day, story: p.story, inbox: useCareer.getState().inbox.length }));
  }, 600_000);
});
